labels: Intended injection phases from collector_evidence_labels.csv; do not label all kill-chain days with all primitives
fit: 8 independent binary XGBoost heads; depth2,160trees,lr.035,minchild20,lambda40,alpha3,gamma.5,subsample.75,colsample.8; capped sqrt imbalance weight20
cutoff: Per label, maximize pooled recall with pooled precision>=70%, >=5 positive predictions, and each calibration precision>=50%; otherwise abstain for label
scope: Supplementary behavior evidence, not a new queue, not an independently trained campaign sequence detector
limitations: Phase annotations are intended synthetic mechanisms, not proof each random increment was nonzero. Final cohorts share mechanisms; no unseen-family claim.
